about: Starter CLEO scripts for 'satk script new'. Placeholders: {{NAME}} file name, {{SNAME}} script name (7 characters), {{CHEAT}}, {{KEY}}, {{MODEL}}, {{X}} {{Y}} {{Z}}, {{TEXT}}. 'uses' lists the options a template reads; 'defaults' fills the ones not given.

hello.about: shows a help message when the game is running, then another one each time a key is pressed

cheat.about: type a cheat code to get $1000, full health and armour

spawn_car.about: type a cheat code to spawn a vehicle (by model id) in front of the player

teleport.about: type a cheat code to teleport the player (or the player's car) to a point

text.about: a key toggles live text on screen every frame (default: the player's position and heading)

mission.about: a small mission loop: a cheat code starts it, reach the marker within 2 minutes for $500
